proposed.text: What minimum slab thickness does PD 1096 require for a reinforced concrete floor slab to achieve a 2-hour fire resistance rating?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Sec. 603 sets RC slab thickness requirements by fire rating: 100mm for 1-hour, 125mm for 2-hour, 150mm for 3-hour, and 150mm for 4-hour ratings.
proposed.explanation: The 125mm threshold for 2-hour rating reflects the increased thermal mass needed to slow heat transmission through the slab. Note that 3-hour and 4-hour ratings share the same 150mm minimum thickness — the additional cover requirements differentiate them at higher ratings.
